description: The first Paystack charge.success of the referred tenant: subscription upgraded and the referral reward created (nothing in the response says so; read it via the marketer API).
note: The pending PaymentTransaction was inserted directly into the scratch database (the normal checkout, POST /api/v1/subscription/upgrade/initialize, calls the real Paystack API). The payload is shaped from what the handler reads (reference, channel, customer, authorization); it is NOT a captured Paystack delivery. It was signed with the same HMAC-SHA512 the endpoint verifies, using the local test PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY.
